en: The postcard shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a city street lined with ornate buildings typical of late 19th to early 20th century European urban architecture. A tram marked 'ORTVIKEN' runs down the middle of the street. There are period street lights and several pedestrians. The street is identified in the top-right as 'Sundsvall. Storgatan.' On the reverse, there's handwritten correspondence in Swedish, a Swedish stamp (5 öre), and addresses referencing Sundsvall and Godegård.
